Home Family Deals in Orlando Universal Orlando Passholder Appreciation Days Return August 15–September 30, 2026

Universal Orlando Passholder Appreciation Days Return August 15–September 30, 2026

Universal Orlando Passholder Appreciation Days Return August 15–September 30, 2026

Listen to audio version of this article
Sponsored by
0:00 / 6:46
Instaread

Universal Orlando Resort is celebrating its Annual and Seasonal Passholders with the return of Passholder Appreciation Days, running from August 15 through September 30, 2026.

During the six-week celebration, eligible Universal Orlando Passholders can enjoy exclusive discounts, limited-time food and merchandise, hotel savings, extended lounge hours and other special benefits throughout Universal Orlando Resort.

The celebration begins with the return of Passholder Nights presented by Coca-Cola, a complimentary after-hours event at Universal Studios Florida on August 15 and 16.

Passholder Nights Return to Universal Studios Florida

Passholder Nights will take place after regular park operating hours on August 15 and 16, 2026.

During the complimentary event, participating Passholders can enjoy select attractions and entertainment, character meet-and-greets, a DJ dance party, special event offerings and a limited-edition magnet giveaway.

Reservations for both Passholder Nights have already reached capacity. Passholders without reservations can still take advantage of the many other offers available during Passholder Appreciation Days.

Exclusive Passholder Discounts and Benefits

Throughout Passholder Appreciation Days, Annual and Seasonal Passholders can access additional savings and perks across Universal Orlando Resort.

Special offers include discounts on:

  • Universal Express Passes
  • Mobile Food and Drink Orders
  • Merchandise
  • Universal Volcano Bay cabanas
  • Premium seating
  • My Universal Photos packages

Passholders can also receive 35% off the My Universal Photos Annual Pass Photo Package when purchasing it inside the resort.

Specific discounts, eligibility requirements and available dates may vary by pass type and location.

Receive a $15 Universal Merchandise Credit

Passholders who spend $100 or more at participating Universal Orlando merchandise locations can receive a $15 merchandise credit.

The credit can be applied toward a future qualifying merchandise purchase. Passholders should review the promotional terms and participating locations before making a purchase.

New Illuminated Globe Merchandise Collection

Passholders will be among the first guests able to shop the new Illuminated Globe Merchandise Collection.

The collection will be available at:

  • The UOAP Lounge in Toon Lagoon at Universal Islands of Adventure
  • The Tonight Shop at Universal Studios Florida

Universal has also announced that Passholders will be able to pick up a complimentary, limited-time specialty item at those two locations while supplies last. Additional information about the item will be released later.

Extended Hours at the UOAP Lounge

During Passholder Appreciation Days, the UOAP Lounge in Toon Lagoon will operate from park opening until park closing.

The extended hours will give Passholders more time to visit the lounge while spending the day at Universal Islands of Adventure.

Availability, capacity and lounge operating procedures may vary.

Limited-Time Passholder Food and Drinks

Universal Orlando will offer an assortment of exclusive menu items at its theme parks, water park and Universal CityWalk.

Universal Studios Florida

Passholders can try:

  • Prosciutto and Arugula Pizza at Louie’s Italian Restaurant
  • The Tipsy Watermelon at Chez Alcatraz

Universal Islands of Adventure

The limited-time menu will include:

  • Three-Cheese Bavarian Pretzel at Pizza Predattoria

Universal Volcano Bay

Passholders can order:

  • Kahuna Bowl at Kohola Reef Restaurant & Social Club

Universal CityWalk

Special menu offerings will include:

  • Chocolate Peanut Butter Explosion at The Toothsome Chocolate Emporium & Savory Feast Kitchen
  • Rocky Road Donut at Voodoo Doughnut
  • Huarache de Chorizo at Antojitos Authentic Mexican Food
  • Triangoletti alla Vodka at Vivo Italian Kitchen
  • Island Fire Chicken and Waffles at Bob Marley—A Tribute to Freedom
  • Pork Dumplings at The Cowfish Sushi Burger Bar

Menu items, prices and availability may vary, and some offerings may be available only for a limited time or while supplies last.

Universal Orlando Hotel Savings for Passholders

Universal Orlando Passholders can also receive savings of up to 40% on select Sunday-through-Thursday hotel stays during Passholder Appreciation Days.

Participating hotels include:

  • Loews Sapphire Falls Resort
  • Universal Stella Nova Resort
  • Universal Terra Luna Resort
  • Universal Endless Summer Resort – Dockside Inn and Suites

Select dining locations at Universal Orlando’s Signature Collection hotels will also offer exclusive Passholder food and beverage options.

Hotel discounts are subject to availability, eligible travel dates and promotional terms. A valid qualifying Annual or Seasonal Pass may be required at check-in.

What Is Universal Orlando Passholder Appreciation Days?

Passholder Appreciation Days is a seasonal celebration created for Universal Orlando’s Annual and Seasonal Passholders.

The event gives Passholders access to extra discounts, limited-time merchandise, exclusive food, complimentary items and other benefits beyond their standard pass perks.

The 2026 celebration runs for approximately six weeks, giving Passholders multiple opportunities to enjoy the offers before the promotion ends on September 30.

Before You Visit

Passholders should check the official Universal Orlando website or mobile app before visiting for:

  • Offer dates and restrictions
  • Participating locations
  • Pass-type eligibility
  • Product and menu availability
  • Hotel discount terms
  • Updated operating hours

Passholders should also bring their valid Annual or Seasonal Pass and a matching photo ID when redeeming offers.

Universal Orlando Passholder Appreciation Days Details

Dates: August 15–September 30, 2026
Location: Universal Orlando Resort
Passholder Nights: August 15 and 16 at Universal Studios Florida
Passholder Nights reservations: Fully committed
Eligibility: Qualifying Universal Orlando Annual and Seasonal Passholders
More information: UniversalOrlando.com

Offers, discounts, menus and merchandise are subject to availability, eligibility requirements, restrictions and change.
